mp 51

Offense

Speed 30 ft.

Melee Dagger +5 (1d4+1/19-20 x2)

Ranged +1 Light Power Staff +8 (1d6+6)

Special Abilities Divine Seal (2/day), Metamagic Enhancement (5/day), Innate Spell (Mage Armor, Light II; [1/day each]), Lay on Hands (11/day, Heal 4d6)

Spells Known (White Mage CL 9th, concentration +14)

5th (DC 20) - Curaga, Lightga

Statistics

Base Atk +4; CMB +5; CMD 19

Feats Combat Casting, Dodge, Extra MP, Quicken Spell, Silent Spell

Skills Spellcraft +11; Racial Modifiers +1 Bluff, +1 Diplomacy;

Languages Common, Vanu

description.value: The elementals know that the Vanu Vanu are more susceptible to attacks from foreign races and monster and grant them their wind ability. Once per day, as a swift action, a vanu can grant himself a +2 deflection bonus to AC against ranged attacks for 1 minute.

effect: +2 deflection vs ranged attacks only, for 1 minute.

description.value: Vanu gain a +1 racial bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks, and they learn one additional language every time they put a rank in the Linguistics skill.

Vanu gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls, a +2 dodge bonus to AC, and a +2 bonus on Perception checks against flying creatures. In addition, enemies on higher ground gain no attack roll bonus against vanu.
Compare against ranged attacks only.
Only vs a flying creature.

This 2-handed mid-ranked staff allows the wielder to shoot elemental energy at a target. When created or bought, they only deal one elemental type of damage (Earth, Fire, Holy, Ice, Lightning, Shadow, Water, or Wind) and are named as such (Fire Staff, Ice Staff, etc).

description.unidentified: A dagger is a fighting knife. Its blade is usually less than 1 foot long, and can be curved or straight, with one edge or two. Dagger designs vary widely, and can have many different names (such as a thrusting dagger being called a "dirk"). You get a +2 bonus on Sleight of Hand skill checks made to conceal a dagger on your body.

Metamagic Enhancement
Lay on Hands

effect: Touch another living ally as standard action.
Against undead only. No save, no AoO.

description.value: Empowered Magic
Healing Spell
Spell Lore
Vigor

An invisible but tangible field of force surrounds the subject of a mage armor spell, providing a +4 armor bonus to AC. Unlike mundane armor, mage armor entails no armor check penalty, arcane spell failure chance, or speed reduction. Since mage armor is made of force, incorporeal creatures can't bypass it the way they do normal armor.

Mage Armor

effect: Cast Mage Armor once per day without MP.

description.value:
You direct a blast of holy energy at your opponent. Requires a ranged touch attack roll to hit that deals 3d6 points of holy damage + your Wisdom modifier + 1 point per caster level (maximum +10) and inflicts the Dazzled status effect for 1d6 rounds. A successful Fortitude save prevents the status effect from taking effect.

Light II

effect: Cast Light II once per day without MP.
